notes.title: [UPDATE] Patch Notes v1.2
notes.content:
Hello, this is Dooms Hair Salon.
We'd like to inform you about the changes in this update v1.2.

Balancing

 The target revenue for solo play has been lowered.
 The ninja spawn rate during solo play has been reduced.
 The price of the bulletproof vest (ending item) has been lowered.
 Player respawn time after death has been reduced from 40 to 20 seconds.
 The price of keyboard instruments has been lowered. They have been changed to be more entertainment-oriented items.


Convenience

 Game save feature has been added. The game automatically saves when starting a new day.
 Movement is now possible when serving NPCs.
 "[Ending Item]" has been added to the bulletproof vest item name to clarify its purpose.
 Tip messages have been added throughout the game to help guide gameplay direction.
 The volume of miner noise sound has been reduced by half.


This update primarily focused on stability and adding the save feature.
We hope this improves the experience for all players going forward.

The direction of the next update will focus on increasing game density.
We aim to update the game so that players can continue to experience new events in the mid to late game until they reach the ending.

Thank you to everyone who plays and enjoys our game.

notes.title: [Notice] Game Release News / Update Direction
notes.content:
Game Release News
Dooms Hair Salon has been released!
This game is a survival simulation with a hair salon theme, with the ultimate goal of purchasing a bulletproof helmet.
We hope you enjoy playing it.

Update Direction
After reviewing the early reviews a few hours after release, we have determined that stability improvements are needed in the game, and have decided to proceed with the following initial update direction.

While content additions should also be considered in the future, for now, we will focus on 'stability' and proceed with the work mentioned above.


 Resolve frame drops
 Add save/load functionality


Currently, the game is GPU-intensive. As a temporary solution, lowering the "Hair Calculation Accuracy" in the in-game Settings-Gameplay menu can improve frame rates. (This is the option that affects performance the most.)

We thank those who played and wrote honest reviews.
We at SlimeBox will do our best to improve the game based on your feedback!
